posts.author: Kilitar
posts.body:
I have one Actor who is always the leader of the group.
And from time to time, he speaks to his squad.
I currently script an event for this, where I "hide the followers" and replace them with events that show their positions so I can do the interaction - and then I put everything back again.
Isn't there a simple script, where I can figure out which way to turn the leader so that they are looking at the follower?
Something like "Turn To Followers".
I also use Visustella Events and movement core plugin, but I did not found such option there either...

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body: the followers are always behind the leader after they move, no? you could set up your events to turn the player 180 with a move route and theyll face the followers

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
You can try this to turn towards Follower 1.
Code:
$gamePlayer.turnTowardCharacter($gamePlayer.followers().follower(0))

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body: There was a way to do this in RPG Maker XP with events that should work in MV/MZ, but using Zia_'s solution would be faster to copy-paste.

posts.author: Eternidade_1
posts.body: There is a way to follow the player, and use events to simulate followers, but you will need to have control over the movements of the events, something that is more than simply using the follow event command. There must be a balance between the two systems because, if the event cannot move, it will not move, it will get stuck somewhere requiring the player to go and get it. In the second case, with the follow player command, the follower will jump to the player when it is stuck or is moving slower.
